The closed list closely matches the Cal-GETC area lists (Areas 1-6, including 5C lab-only courses GEOG 015, GEOLOGY 006/007, PHYSICS 014), suggesting this certificate may be a Cal-GETC/GE certificate, but the text does not label it as this award; a reviewer should locate the actual Essential Skills certificate page.

The general education outcomes printed ('Students who complete general education at LACC will:') belong to GE for associate degrees, not explicitly to this award, so they were not recorded as program outcomes.
The page headers read 'LACC 2025-2026 COLLEGE CATALOG' although the requested catalog year is 2026-2027.
The text is cut off mid-sentence at the end of page 61 (US History, Constitution, and American Ideals).
